== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ハンのサイコロ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘で、戦闘運命数を引いた時に使う。自分の能力値2以上のキャラクターが参加していないと使えない。1フォース消費して 引いた戦闘運命数をキャンセルし、新しい戦闘運命数を引ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ミレニアム ファルコンのコクピットには、お守りに一組のサイコロが吊してある。「全てを操る万能なるフォースなんてものには、お目にかかったことがねえ。」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Han's Dice]].

'''Lore''' — A pair of dice hangs in the Millennium Falcon's cockpit as a good-luck charm. “I've never laid eyes on an all-powerful Force that controls everything.”

'''Game text''' — Use when a battle destiny is drawn in battle. You cannot use it unless one of your characters with ability 2 or more is participating. Use 1 Force to cancel that battle destiny and draw a new one.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Ability 2 or more vs ability > 2. Cancel the drawn battle destiny and draw a new one vs draw another instead of the one just drawn.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-hansdice.gif|Original English face]], [[Han's Dice]].</ref>
